items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: For a while, going into 1949, I kind of alternated between playing with Dinah Washington and Billie.

ctx.x: that. Anyway, I worked a while with Dinah Washington, and oh... For a while, going into 1949, I kind of alternated between playing with Dinah Washington and Billie. It seems like a couple of times I would work with one for a few weeks and the other for a few weeks -- never over a long period. This kind of situation went on, and in between these times, either I would have a trio or I would be working with somebody's trio in and around Washington. And I did that up until 1950.

In 1950, I got this group together to work in a room that was in a hotel in Washington. It was a Black hotel, and they had a room there called the 2011 Room. They brought in big people. Like, the Nat King Cole Trio played there, George Shearing's Quintet, and we were the house band. This band that I had was six pieces, or six musicians.
